title: Lisbon's Wavy Rhythm
description: Chilling by the grand fountain where classic cobbled waves lead straight into the city's lively heart.
altText: Broad city square in Lisbon featuring a dark bronze fountain, tall monument column, and distinctive black-and-white wave-patterned cobblestone pavement.

title: Alfama Horizon Dreams
description: Sweeping views over coastal rooftops and white church spires where the city meets the calm blue waters.
altText: High-angle panoramic view of Lisbon's Alfama district featuring white buildings with red-tiled roofs leading towards the river bank.

title: Framed City Vistas
description: Peer through ancient stone arches for a breathtaking look over Lisbon's endless sea of terracotta roofs.
altText: View through a pointed stone window frame looking out over colourful cityscape buildings and red roofs under a blue sky.

title: Golden Hour Glow
description: Catching magic over the river as the setting sun paints the skyline in dazzling gold.
altText: Bright golden sunset over a wide river, casting brilliant light across the water towards a distant suspension bridge and monument silhouette.

title: Golden Plaza Dusk
description: Soaking in the warm twilight skies and grand historic silhouettes across Lisbon's open square.
altText: Grand square in Lisbon at sunset with a bronze equestrian statue on a high pedestal set against a fiery yellow sky.
